validation.how: Errors render only in a 'Needs review' card after every section (first 25 messages, no field marker); Queue for submission is disabled while any exist.

findings.now: The year is an editable box prefilled from the tile, and saving after a change writes the draft under that other year and replaces any saved Draft already stored there.
findings.why: The taxable year is part of the save key, and upsert_from_draft updates an existing Draft row without asking (crates/bir-core/src/db/queueable.rs:154-166).

options.name: Read-only chip
options.detail: Show the tile's year as fixed text so the save key cannot move from this page.

options.name: Confirm before moving
options.detail: If the year stays editable, ask before saving under another year and refuse to overwrite an existing Draft.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: Offer only the tile's year and the year before it in a combobox.

findings.now: From the 13th 0605 payment of a tax year, the dashboard tile opens payment 12's record instead of a new draft.
findings.why: The dashboard passes the next open-ended key (crates/bir-desktop/src/views/dashboard.rs:1133), but load_draft and new_from_profile clamp it to 1–12, so the 'Open-ended persistence slot must be from 1 to 12' check (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_0605_official.rs:665) can never fire.

options.name: Refuse with a message
options.detail: Show a plain message that this year's in-app 0605 slots are used up instead of opening slot 12.

options.name: Keep the real key
options.detail: Store the open-ended key unclamped; FilingPeriod::OpenEnded holds a u32 and the queue column is an i64.

findings.now: Item 3 opens with a quarter already selected from the payment count, so payment 1 shows Q1, payment 2 shows Q2, and payment 4 onward shows Q4.
findings.why: new_from_profile sets quarter from the clamped open-ended key (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_0605.rs:489), although the model says the slot is not used to derive the quarter (form_0605.rs:385-386).

options.name: Start unset
options.detail: Default Item 3 to None and make the user pick Q1–Q4 on each return.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: Offer None and Q1–Q4 in a combobox with None selected until the user picks one.

findings.now: The two approval buttons, 'Pre-approved by Investigating Office' and 'Not approved by Investigating Office', write the two XML approval flags as if their meaning were known.
findings.why: The model says neither reviewed save sets those flags and their meaning is not established (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_0605.rs:103-105 and 550), so the label-to-flag pairing is an assumption.

options.name: Flag for review
options.detail: Keep the official sentence and list the approval flags as unverified in Needs review until their meaning is confirmed.

options.name: Neutral labels
options.detail: Show 'Option 1' and 'Option 2' beside the official sentence so the page claims no mapping.

findings.now: A mistyped or impossible Item 7 date, such as 02/29/2025, shows the generic line Item 7 — Return period (MM/DD/YYYY): "…" is not a MM/DD/YYYY date. instead of the official alert text.
findings.why: The official alerts for the format, leap-year, month, day and year branches of Items 4 and 7 (rules/forms/0605-v2003/validations.json rules 15, 17, 22, 24, 36, 37, 39, 41, 42, 44) have no port, so their verbatim text never appears.

options.name: Port the official alerts
options.detail: Return each official text for its own branch, in the official rule order, instead of the generic messages.

options.name: Split the date input
options.detail: Use separate month, day and year boxes so each official alert maps to one field.

findings.now: The page shows the name and address as typed or loaded, but the queued XML uppercases the name, address, line of business and Item 17 'Others' text every time.
findings.why: The recorded rule is that capital() fires only on blur and profile-loaded fields keep their case (memory note bir-caps-display-only), but the port applies capital() unconditionally.

options.name: Match the blur rule
options.detail: Apply capital() only to values the user edited on the page, as the official blur handler does.

options.name: Keep the case as entered
options.detail: Store the typed case in the XML and leave the uppercase display to the print renderer, as the memory note requires.

findings.now: Up to 24 ATC chips appear at once under a separate 'Find an ATC' box, out of 122 offered for a non-PT tax type (144 in total).
findings.why: A single ATC from a list this size needs a combobox, because the chip list shows only the first 24 matches and hides the rest until the user types.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: A single-select combobox that filters the offered ATCs as the user types.

options.name: Select with search
options.detail: A searchable select that opens the full list already limited to the chosen tax type.

findings.now: Errors appear only in a 'Needs review' card after every section (first 25 messages, no field marker), and 'Queue for submission' is disabled with no reason beside it.
findings.why: The user has to scroll past the whole form to learn which item blocks filing, because no field carries its own message.

options.name: Inline error text
options.detail: Show each message under its own field, using the official alert wording.

options.name: Pinned summary
options.detail: Show the error count and jump links next to the Queue button.

findings.now: Twelve month buttons wrap across the Return period card, and all are disabled under the default Calendar basis, with December still disabled under Fiscal.
findings.why: Twelve options are too many for a button row, the row does nothing until Item 1 changes, and a combobox fits more than four options.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: Jan–Dec in one combobox, enabled only when Item 1 is Fiscal.

options.name: Fixed text
options.detail: Under Calendar, show 'Dec' as read-only text and show the combobox only for Fiscal.

findings.now: Seven buttons wrap across the Part II card, and choosing 'Others (Specify)' reveals a description box below them.
findings.why: Seven exclusive choices are more than a button row should carry, and each long label takes its own chip width.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: One combobox with the seven official manners, revealing the description box for 'Others (Specify)'.

options.name: Radio list
options.detail: A vertical radio group, one manner per line, so the long labels fit at phone width.
